components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Harbor Coral conversion action; one per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { font-family: 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; background: #ff5a5f; color: #00102d; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 26px; min-width: 132px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.25s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #e3444a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d7ea8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Dark Button
components.description: Secondary action; inverts to sailcloth on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-dark { font-family: 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; background: rgba(0,16,45,0.92); color: #ece6d6; text-decoration: none; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 4px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 26px; min-width: 132px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.25s, color 0.25s; } .ds-btn-dark:hover { background: #ece6d6; color: #00102d; } .ds-btn-dark:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d7ea8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { font-family: 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; border: 1px solid rgba(236,230,214,0.5); color: #ece6d6; text-decoration: none; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; padding: 18px 40px; display: inline-block; transition: background 0.25s, border-color 0.25s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: rgba(236,230,214,0.12); border-color: #ece6d6; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d7ea8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Round Icon Control
components.css: .ds-icon-round { background: rgba(0,32,91,0.45); border: 1px solid rgba(236,230,214,0.4); color: #ece6d6; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; transition: background 0.25s; } .ds-icon-round:hover { background: rgba(0,32,91,0.75); } .ds-icon-round:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d7ea8; outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation
components.description: Desktop bar with uppercase tracked links.
components.html: CelestineYachtDestinationsGalleryCrewRates
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; background: #ece6d6; padding: 18px 32px; } .ds-nav-logo { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; color: #00205b; margin-right: 24px; } .ds-nav a { color: #273f54; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 13px; letter-spacing: 2px; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.7; transition: opacity 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-nav a:hover { opacity: 1; color: #00205b; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #4d7ea8; outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: 2px; }

components.name: Stats Band
components.description: Navy four-column fact strip with serif numerals.
components.css: .ds-stats { background: #00205b; color: #ece6d6; display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); } .ds-stats div { padding: 32px 16px; text-align: center; border-left: 1px solid rgba(236,230,214,0.18); } .ds-stats div:first-child { border-left: none; } .ds-stats strong { display: block; font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 46px; line-height: 1; } .ds-stats span { display: block; margin-top: 8px; font-family: 'Jost', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 12px; letter-spacing: 3px; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.8; }

narrative.overview:
Celestine reads like a navigator's chart table made elegant: deep navy fields printed with blueprint and orthographic yacht drawings, alternating with warm sailcloth-ivory pages. Cormorant Garamond sets headlines like entries in a well-kept log, and small, widely tracked uppercase Jost labels act as the instrument annotations. The sailing-yacht character is technical and crafted, never glossy motor-yacht chrome.

The page moves in full-bleed sections that alternate between the two worlds: navy/blueprint for atmosphere (stats, destinations, virtual tour, booking) and sailcloth for detail and decision-making (gallery, crew, layout, rates, availability). Density is generous: 56px section gutters, large serif headlines, and light-weight body copy. Motion is slow and calm: reveals over 0.8–1.2s with a soft ease-out, and all of it respects reduced-motion preferences.
keyCharacteristics: Two-world rhythm: navy blueprint sections and sailcloth ivory sections.
Serif display headlines (Cormorant Garamond, 400) over light sans body text (Jost, 300).
Uppercase tracked labels (2–4px letter-spacing) for navigation, stats, and actions.
Technical drawings (blueprints, orthographic views, cutaways) used as texture and proof.
Square-cornered action buttons; circular controls only for icon-only carousel/lightbox navigation.
Harbor Coral reserved for the primary conversion action.

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Every section is either Navy (text in Sailcloth) or Sailcloth (text in Navy or Chart Ink). Don't introduce white or gray section backgrounds.

rules.name: The One Coral Rule
rules.body: Harbor Coral marks the single most important action in a view. Never use it for decoration, text, or more than one competing button.

rules.name: The Brand Sheet Rule
rules.body: New colors come from the Celestine Brand Palette (uploads/Celestine_Brand_Palette.pdf); Harbor Coral is the only approved addition.

rules.name: The Logbook Voice Rule
rules.body: Serif for things you'd say; tracked uppercase sans for things you'd annotate. Never set labels in Cormorant or headlines in Jost.

rules.name: The Light Hand Rule
rules.body: Body copy stays at weight 300 and headlines at 400. Bold weights are not part of the system.

rules.name: The Paper, Not Plastic Rule
rules.body: Sections sit flat. Only elements that float over content (overlays, lightbox, controls on imagery) get shadows.

dos: Do alternate Navy and Sailcloth sections, each with 56px padding.
Do set headlines in Cormorant Garamond 400 and labels in uppercase Jost with 2–4px tracking.
Do use the blueprint, orthographic, and cutaway drawings as texture and proof of the vessel.
Do keep action buttons square, with Harbor Coral for the single primary action and Dark or Ghost for the rest.
Do keep the 3px Steel Blue focus ring, and give every new animation a prefers-reduced-motion counterpart (no looping sway, no slide; a short opacity fade at most).
Do keep reveal motion slow and soft (0.6–1.2s, cubic-bezier(0.22, 0.61, 0.36, 1)).
Do keep functional labels at 12px or larger, at 0.72 opacity or more.
donts: Don't add colors outside the Celestine Brand Palette besides Harbor Coral.
Don't use more than one coral action competing in the same view.
Don't round action buttons into pills; pills are for icon-only controls.
Don't use bold weights or set body copy in the serif.
Don't add white or cool-gray section backgrounds in place of Sailcloth.
Don't set ivory or white text on Harbor Coral or Harbor Sky fills.
